gen-gf-swanky-and-moo-moo-fs-fira-sans: One fixed nib draws every stroke of Swanky and Moo Moo, so the letters look casually jotted down. Fira Sans, plain sans with a generous x-height, can drop a size and still read clearly in quick glances.
gen-gf-swanky-and-moo-moo-fs-public-sans: Public Sans reads sturdy and open, with a hefty lowercase. Stretched across a full page its broad counters keep things open, yet this sans-serif beside Swanky and Moo Moo is happiest in modest helpings.
gen-gf-swanky-and-moo-moo-fs-supreme: Swanky and Moo Moo draws every stroke at the width of one stylus, a loose, friendly hand with barely any capital lift. Swanky charms in a word or two; Supreme keeps heavy, open lines going.
gen-gf-swanky-and-moo-moo-general-sans: General Sans keeps a steady pen pressure from first letter to last, its tall x-height filling the line. Beside Swanky and Moo Moo it glides smoothly, best in quick visits.
gen-gf-swanky-and-moo-moo-manrope: Swanky and Moo Moo writes like a relaxed hand, one nib throughout. Handwritten charm is its best trick, while sans-serif Manrope does its best work with bright open curves in a few modest lines.
gen-gf-swanky-and-moo-moo-montserrat: Letters from one fixed nib give Swanky and Moo Moo a casual, jotted-down feel. Montserrat, in plain sans form, adds geometric curves with generous white space, which suits a few lines of text.
gen-gf-swanky-and-moo-moo-satoshi: Swanky and Moo Moo is drawn with one fixed nib, so every letter feels casual and relaxed. Satoshi, a sans-serif with a soaring x-height, keeps reading smooth and light, best in quick bursts.
gen-gf-swanky-and-moo-moo-switzer: A casual capital that barely rises above its neighbors gives Swanky and Moo Moo a jotted, friendly look. Switzer, the sans-serif, brings tubular wire-like tidiness, better for a line or two than a wall of text.
gen-gf-swanky-and-moo-moo-work-sans: Relaxed and inviting, Swanky and Moo Moo looks like it was jotted down with a single nib. Work Sans, a sans-serif with a high mean line, sits under it for quick, modern reading.
gen-gf-syne-tactile-fs-karma: Karma is a trustworthy serif with a tight cap-to-lowercase step. Beside the broad-nibbed, expressive Syne Tactile it feels quietly grounded and classic, like a firm handshake after a flourish.
